title: VPN access keeps dropping
description: Hey, my VPN keeps dropping every 15 minutes today and it's super disruptive. I'm on Windows 11 using Cisco AnyConnect—any chance someone could take a look? Thanks!
resolution: Identified conflicting MTU settings on the user's home ISP router; adjusted client-side VPN adapter settings to accommodate packet fragmentation.

title: VPN connection failing
description: I am formally reporting a persistent technical issue regarding connectivity to the corporate network via the GlobalProtect VPN client. Despite successfully authorizing the Duo push notification, the application consistently returns an "Authentication Failed" error message, preventing any network access. This issue is occurring on a device running macOS Sonoma 14.2. Please investigate this authentication failure as a matter of priority.
resolution: Updated the GlobalProtect client certificate on the user's device and cleared the cached SAML assertion in the browser.

title: Salesforce login loop on Chrome
description: I am losing my mind because Salesforce is trapped in a non-stop redirect loop every single time I try to log in. I’ve already wasted my time clearing the cache and cookies on Chrome v120.0, but it’s still doing the exact same thing—just refreshing the login page over and over again. Fix this immediately.
resolution: Cleared corrupted browser cache files and updated Salesforce security certificates in the user's profile.

title: Unauthorized Device Alert
description: Hey, the NAC just blocked a device on port 24 (MAC: 00:1A:2B:3C:4D:5E) because it's trying to hit the prod network. Could you take a look?
resolution: Investigated the device and confirmed it was a personal laptop; moved the port to the restricted VLAN.

title: System slow after suspected malware
description: I am formally reporting a significant degradation in workstation performance following the inadvertent activation of a suspicious hyperlink. The 'System' process is currently exhibiting sustained CPU utilization at 100%. Given the nature of the symptoms, I am concerned that the machine has been compromised by malicious software, potentially a crypto-mining utility, and I request an immediate security assessment.
resolution: Ran a full malware scan, removed a malicious browser extension, and restored system performance.

title: Guest Wi-Fi is down
description: Our visitors are completely unable to connect to the Guest network. They’re stuck staring at the splash page, and the authentication fails every single time they try to log in. This is becoming a major issue, so please get it fixed immediately.
resolution: Restarted the WLC authentication service which had stopped responding; guest portal is now successfully issuing tokens.

title: Network slow, help?
description: Hey, is the internet acting up for anyone else? Everything's running super slow and I can’t seem to load any files from the server. Anything going on?
resolution: Investigated bandwidth utilization and discovered a large unauthorized backup process running on a workstation; throttled the process and optimized local QoS settings.

title: SSD wear level alert
description: I am writing to formally report that our server monitoring system has issued an alert indicating that the solid-state drives (SSDs) within our cache tier have reached a 92% wear level. Although the system currently remains operational, I am concerned regarding the long-term stability of this hardware. Please provide a formal assessment of the urgency of this issue and advise on the required timeframe for scheduling a proactive replacement to prevent potential service disruption.
resolution: Analyzed the S.M.A.R.T. data and confirmed the drives are still within operational spec; scheduled a proactive replacement for the next quarterly maintenance cycle.

title: Adobe Acrobat crashes on startup
description: I am beyond fed up with Adobe Acrobat Pro DC. Every single time I try to open a PDF, the application crashes immediately. I’ve already wasted my time doing a full reinstallation of the entire Creative Cloud suite, and it didn't do a damn thing. I'm running Windows 11 Pro 22H2, and the Event Viewer is clearly pointing to the faulting module name: Acrobat.dll, version: 23.8.20470.0. Get this fixed, I have actual work to do.
resolution: Performed a clean registry scrub using the Adobe Removal Tool and reinstalled the application using the enterprise MSI installer.

title: Help! Table dropped by accident
description: Hey, total disaster here—I accidentally ran a DROP TABLE instead of TRUNCATE on the customer_audit_logs table in staging. Could you please help me restore it ASAP?
resolution: Restored the table from the latest Point-in-Time Recovery (PITR) snapshot taken at 02:00 AM.

title: Lost my YubiKey
description: I am writing to formally report the loss of my assigned hardware security key. Please provide instructions on the procurement process for a replacement device and the necessary procedures to revoke the credentials of the lost key from my account. As this device is essential for accessing internal systems, I request that this matter be prioritized to restore my ability to perform my professional duties.
resolution: Deactivated the lost hardware key in Okta and provided the user with a temporary bypass code until a replacement arrives.

title: Locked out of AD account
description: I am beyond frustrated. I’m locked out of my account yet again. I tried my password three times, and now it’s giving me the "Account is locked due to multiple failed attempts" error. This is the third time this week this has happened—can someone please actually fix this?
resolution: Unlocked the AD account and cleared cached credentials on the user's workstation that were causing repeated lockout triggers.

title: Duplicate records in production
description: Hey, looks like we’ve got thousands of duplicate entries in the audit_logs table—seems like the batch job is running twice. Can we get that cleaned up?
resolution: Used a Common Table Expression (CTE) to identify and delete duplicate rows while retaining the earliest record.

title: SSH timeout to dev server
description: I am formally reporting a persistent connectivity failure when attempting to initiate an SSH session with the staging server (10.0.50.22) from my local macOS Monterey environment. This issue, characterized by a 'Connection timed out' error, represents a regression from the previous day's successful access. Please investigate whether any recent modifications to firewall configurations have been implemented that would restrict this connection.
resolution: Added the user's current dynamic IP range to the whitelist on the perimeter firewall.

title: Can't connect to VPN
description: I am losing my mind here. My Cisco AnyConnect VPN was working perfectly fine yesterday morning, and now all of a sudden, it refuses to connect on macOS Monterey, constantly throwing an "invalid server certificate" error. I have work to do and this is completely blocking me—fix this immediately.
resolution: Updated the root CA certificate on the user's machine as the previous one had expired.

title: Intermittent packet loss on main server uplink
description: Hey, heads up—we’re seeing about 15% packet loss on the SFP+ uplink between the server rack and the distribution switch. It looks like it started right after that fiber patch cable got moved during the site audit. The latency spikes are causing SQL timeouts, so we might need to take a look at that connection.
resolution: Replaced the damaged OM4 fiber patch cable which showed high insertion loss during testing.

title: Adobe Creative Cloud License missing
description: Following the recent update to the Adobe Creative Cloud application on my macOS workstation, the software incorrectly indicates that my trial period has expired. This is in direct conflict with my active, company-provisioned enterprise subscription. Please investigate this authentication error and restore access to my licensed applications as a matter of urgency.
resolution: Re-assigned Adobe CC license in the Admin Console and forced a sign-out/sign-in refresh on the local client.

title: Website blocked by firewall
description: I am completely unable to access the essential research portal I need for my project because the firewall is falsely flagging it as 'Malware/Phishing.' This site is clearly safe and I am being prevented from doing my actual work. Please fix this immediately.
resolution: Whitelisted the specific URL in the web filter policy after verifying the site's reputation and security certificate.

title: SQL Server connection timeout on App-Prod-01
description: Hey, we're having some trouble with the frontend connecting to the main SQL Server 2019 instance. It’s hitting intermittent "Login timeout expired" errors exactly every 15 minutes, which is preventing users from saving changes in the portal. Any ideas?
resolution: Adjusted the connection pool settings in the web.config and increased the server-side query timeout threshold to resolve locking conflicts.

title: Switch port 12 down
description: I am formally reporting a persistent service disruption affecting the lobby wireless access point. Port 12 on the switch stack located in IDF-02 has entered an err-disabled state, resulting in a total loss of uplink connectivity. Please initiate a formal investigation into this failure and restore network access as a matter of priority.
resolution: Identified a flapping issue caused by a faulty patch cable; replaced the Cat6 cable and re-enabled the interface.

title: Cannot reach external website
description: I’m trying to access our cloud accounting software and keep getting a connection timeout error, which is completely blocking my workflow. My internet is clearly working fine since I can load Google without any issues, so this is obviously an issue with this specific site. I need this fixed immediately because I can't get any of my work done.
resolution: White-listed the cloud provider's new IP range on the edge firewall.

title: Ethernet port dead on workstation 402
description: Hey, my HP EliteDesk isn't getting any link lights on the NIC. I've already tried swapping in a known-good Cat6 cable and testing a different wall jack, but still nothing. Any ideas?
resolution: Traced the wall jack to a faulty port on the Cisco Catalyst switch; moved the patch cable to a different, active switch port.

title: Office lights are flickering
description: Persistent flickering of the lighting fixtures in the west wing has recurred. I am concerned that these electrical fluctuations may pose a stability risk to the adjacent server infrastructure. Please dispatch a technician to investigate and resolve this issue as a matter of urgency.
resolution: Electrical contractor tightened a loose neutral wire in the main circuit breaker panel.

title: Unable to access VPN client
description: I am beyond frustrated at this point. My Cisco AnyConnect client is just hanging on "Connecting" indefinitely and refuses to actually log me in. I’ve already wasted time restarting my laptop twice and verifying my internet is working perfectly fine, but absolutely nothing has changed. I need access to the internal server to do my job—can someone please fix this immediately?
resolution: Flushed the local DNS cache and updated the Cisco AnyConnect Secure Mobility Client to the latest version compatible with the current network firmware.

title: Blocked website access
description: Hey, quick question—I’m getting an "Access Denied: Malicious Sites" error when trying to check some project docs. I know the site is safe, but it looks like the firewall is blocking me. Could you help me get through so I can finish this research?
resolution: Reviewed the site's reputation, whitelisted the URL in the Zscaler policy, and cleared the user's browser cache.

title: Access to Jira board denied
description: I am writing to formally report an access issue regarding the 'Q3 Infrastructure Project' board in Jira. Despite my team members maintaining full visibility of the board, I am consistently receiving an 'Insufficient Permissions' error message when attempting to access it. I request a thorough review of my user profile and account permissions to rectify this discrepancy and restore my access to the project board.
resolution: Added user to the 'Jira_Infrastructure_Project' permission scheme.

title: Zoom audio sync lag
description: I am beyond frustrated that the audio is constantly lagging behind the video during every single all-hands meeting. My network latency is perfectly fine, yet the Zoom desktop client insists on spiking my CPU usage to 90% every time I’m in a call. This is completely unacceptable and making it impossible to work.
resolution: Updated Zoom client to the latest version and adjusted audio device buffer settings in the application.

title: VPN connection failure
description: Hey, is anyone else having trouble with the VPN after the Cisco AnyConnect 4.10 update? It was working fine yesterday, but now it’s just throwing an "Unable to establish connection to the remote gateway" error whenever I try to connect.
resolution: Updated the root certificate store on the local client machine and re-authenticated the user against the RADIUS server.

title: Printer on 2nd floor is unreachable
description: This formal notification serves to report a persistent connectivity failure regarding the LaserJet Pro M402n located on the 2nd floor. The device is currently inaccessible via the network, resulting in consistent "Host Unreachable" error messages for all users attempting to submit print jobs. Physical inspection confirms that the Ethernet cable is securely connected; however, the printer's status indicator is displaying a solid amber light, indicating a critical hardware or configuration fault that requires immediate technical intervention.
resolution: Reset the static IP configuration on the printer interface and assigned it a new reserved address via DHCP.

title: Unable to run PowerShell scripts as admin
description: My machine (WS-DESK-99) is completely blocked because of these ridiculous execution policy restrictions. I’ve already tried running 'Set-ExecutionPolicy RemoteSigned' myself, but surprise, surprise—it’s throwing an "access denied" error. I have actual work to do and I’m currently dead in the water; I need this fixed immediately so I can finally finish my testing.
resolution: Granted temporary local administrator rights to user to update the execution policy for their development environment.

title: Unable to reach external website
description: Hey, we're trying to get into the vendor portal at www.vendor-secure.com, but our firewall is blocking it. We're getting an "Access Denied: Category Restricted" error page—could you help us get that unblocked?
resolution: Added the vendor domain to the corporate firewall whitelist as an exception for the relevant department.

title: URGENT: Database corruption error
description: This communication serves as a formal report regarding a critical service interruption affecting the CRM production instance. The system has generated a "Database page corruption detected" error, resulting in a total inability to access or retrieve client records. Given the severe impact on business operations and the resulting disruption to the sales department, I request that this matter be treated with the highest priority and resolved immediately.
resolution: Restored the database from the last successful hourly snapshot and performed a checksum validation to ensure data integrity.

title: Cannot access shared drive
description: I am once again unable to access the \\FileServer01\Marketing drive and keep getting hit with the "Network path not found" error (0x80070035). I’m running Windows 10 Pro and this is completely blocking my workflow. Please fix this.
resolution: Flushed DNS cache and re-mapped the network drive using the server's static IP address instead of the hostname.

title: Adobe Creative Cloud installation failure
description: Hey, having some trouble installing Photoshop on my M2 MacBook Pro (running Sonoma 14.2). The installer keeps crashing at 42% with error code 191. I’ve already tried clearing the OOBE folder cache and restarted the machine twice, but it’s still hitting the same wall. Any ideas?
resolution: Resolved by running the Adobe Creative Cloud Cleaner Tool to remove corrupted registry artifacts and reinstalling the app from the enterprise portal.

title: Static IP conflict
description: Our network management system is consistently triggering alerts indicating an IP address conflict involving 192.168.1.50. It appears that two distinct devices are contending for this singular address, resulting in network instability. I request that your team investigate these alerts immediately to identify the conflicting hardware and resolve the addressing issue.
resolution: Identified a rogue wireless router plugged into a wall jack by a user; disabled the port and confiscated the device.

title: Permission issue
description: I need read access to the marketing database ASAP. My manager already approved this request, but I still can't connect with my credentials. I keep getting an 'Access denied for user' error and I'm tired of wasting time on this. Fix it.
resolution: Granted SELECT permissions on the 'marketing_prod' schema to the user's AD group.

title: Stuck in a loop, need help!
description: Hey, having some trouble with my local dev DB—tried running a simple update script and now it’s just hanging indefinitely. It’s MySQL 8.0 on Ubuntu 22.04. Every time I try to run a SELECT query now, it just spins and never returns anything. Any ideas?
resolution: Identified a deadlocked transaction caused by an uncommitted update. Killed the process ID and advised the user to implement explicit transaction handling.

title: Unable to export reports from PowerBI
description: I am writing to formally report an issue regarding the dashboard export functionality. Despite utilizing the desktop application and confirming that my user permissions remain unchanged, the export button is currently disabled and unresponsive. I request an immediate investigation into this technical impediment to restore the expected functionality.
resolution: Updated PowerBI Desktop to the latest monthly release; the issue was caused by an expired local authentication token.

title: Intermittent connectivity on VLAN 20
description: We’re dealing with constant, intermittent network drops on the accounting subnet (VLAN 20) and it's completely killing productivity. My users are losing their connection to the file server every 15-20 minutes, and while it reconnects on its own after 30 seconds, this cycle is unacceptable. I’ve already wasted time checking the uplink port on the core switch and there are zero CRC errors, so the issue is clearly somewhere else. Fix this already.
resolution: Replaced faulty SFP+ module on the distribution switch stack.

title: Core Switch Uplink Flapping
description: Hey, heads up—we're getting intermittent drops on the main uplink (Te1/0/1) for the 9300 dist switch. It’s hitting ERR_DISABLE every 15-20 mins due to link flapping, which is causing latency spikes across the entire 3rd-floor VLAN.
resolution: Replaced the SFP+ transceiver and patched the fiber cable; port stability restored.

title: Database performance extremely slow after patch
description: Following the deployment of OS patches to the Oracle 19c database server on RHEL 8 during the maintenance window last night, the application has experienced a 400% increase in latency. Preliminary analysis indicates a critical degradation in performance characterized by abnormally high IO wait times. This issue is currently impacting all users within the EMEA region, and we require an immediate investigation and resolution to restore standard service levels.
resolution: Identified a misconfiguration in the transparent huge pages settings post-patch; reverted to optimal kernel parameters.

title: Guest Wi-Fi portal not loading
description: People are complaining that they can connect to the Guest_WiFi just fine, but the splash page never actually loads. Everyone is stuck with a "No Internet" error and the connection just times out. This is completely broken and needs to be fixed immediately.
resolution: Restarted the WLC (Wireless LAN Controller) service and cleared stale sessions from the guest VLAN.

title: Suspicious phishing email reporting
description: Hey team, just a heads-up that I got a phishy email from an external address posing as HR asking for payroll info. It’s got a sketchy link to a non-company domain, so I haven't clicked anything—just wanted to flag it for you guys to check out.
resolution: Verified the email as a phishing attempt, blocked the sender domain on the mail gateway, and purged the message from the user's inbox.

title: Latency spikes in VLAN 20
description: This correspondence serves to formally document persistent performance degradation affecting Finance department personnel while accessing cloud-based ERP resources. Network diagnostic analysis, specifically traceroute data, isolates the source of these latency spikes to the Distribution Layer switch, identified as DIST-SW-02. Furthermore, current monitoring confirms that CPU utilization on the switch backplane is exhibiting critical fluctuations between 85% and 95%, indicating a severe hardware or configuration deficiency that requires immediate remediation.
resolution: Identified a broadcast storm caused by a loop on an unmanaged switch in the Finance office; removed the rogue device and implemented port security.

title: Rack A-02 Power Outage
description: The entire rack in A-02 is completely dead and the PDU is showing a 0A load. This is ridiculous—I’m almost certain the breaker in the facility room tripped. Fix this immediately.
resolution: Reset the tripped circuit breaker in the PDU and load-balanced hardware to prevent recurrence.

title: SAML SSO error on Chrome
description: Hey, I'm running into an "Error 403: app_not_configured_for_user" when trying to launch Salesforce through Okta. I'm on Chrome v118 and Windows 11, and it seems like everyone else on the team is getting in fine. Any idea what's up?
resolution: Assigned the user to the Salesforce application integration in Okta Admin Console.

title: Adobe Acrobat Pro crashing on startup
description: I am writing to formally report a persistent functional failure regarding Adobe Acrobat. Upon attempting to open any PDF document, the application terminates immediately, consistently displaying error code 0xc0000005. I am currently operating on the latest version of macOS Sonoma. This recurring technical issue has become a significant impediment to my professional responsibilities, specifically hindering my ability to perform required contract reviews. Please prioritize the resolution of this matter.
resolution: Performed a clean re-installation of Adobe Acrobat using the Adobe Cleaner Tool to remove residual registry entries.

title: MFA device lost
description: I’ve managed to lose my phone, which—of course—had the Microsoft Authenticator app on it. Now I’m completely locked out of my email and can’t get any work done. How am I supposed to regain access to my account when the security setup is preventing me from logging in? I need this fixed immediately.
resolution: Verified user identity via manager, reset the MFA requirement for the account, and assisted the user in setting up a new device.

title: Guest Wi-Fi portal not loading
description: Hey! Heads up that the guest Wi-Fi captive portal isn't popping up for mobile users—everyone is getting stuck on "Connected, No Internet." We really need this squared away before the conference tomorrow. Thanks!
resolution: Restarted the WLC controller service and flushed the DNS entries for the portal redirect URL.

title: Unable to run sudo commands
description: I am writing to formally report an issue regarding my Ubuntu 22.04 workstation. As of today, I have lost administrative privileges, and any attempt to execute commands requiring elevated access results in a "User is not in the sudoers file" error. This is a regression in service, as I possessed the necessary permissions to execute these commands successfully as of yesterday. Please investigate this sudden revocation of my sudo access as a matter of urgency.
resolution: Added the user back to the 'sudo' group and verified the integrity of the /etc/sudoers file.

title: Slow internet speeds
description: The internet is basically unusable for the entire accounting team today. Pages are taking an eternity to load and our cloud software keeps timing out constantly. Is someone throttling our connection or is there some ridiculous bandwidth cap active that nobody bothered to tell us about?
resolution: Identified a massive background OS update consuming 90% of the circuit bandwidth; implemented QoS policy to throttle Windows Update traffic.

title: Office printer offline
description: Hey, the big 3rd-floor Xerox is acting up and showing a "Network Error" again. I already tried restarting it, but it's still offline. Could someone take a look?
resolution: Corrected an IP address conflict; assigned a static reservation in the DHCP scope to prevent the printer from grabbing an existing address.

title: Forgotten MFA device
description: I am writing to formally report an issue regarding my inability to access company systems from the office. Due to the inadvertent omission of my company-issued Yubikey, I am currently unable to authenticate via the required Okta prompt. I request an urgent temporary bypass of this authentication protocol to facilitate my work requirements for today.
resolution: Verified identity via manager and issued a one-time bypass code valid for 4 hours.

description: My laptop is absolutely useless because the Wi-Fi keeps dropping every five minutes. I've already restarted the machine twice and nothing changes. I checked the device manager and it's throwing a Code 10 error for the "Intel Wi-Fi 6 AX200," which clearly shows the driver is failing. Can someone actually fix this so I can get back to work?

title: Forgotten MFA device
description: Hey, I’m traveling for a conference and realized I left my security key back at the office. I’m currently locked out of my email—any chance you can help me get access? Really need to check my inbox before tomorrow’s meeting.

title: Unauthorized device detected on secure port
description: This correspondence serves as a formal notification regarding a security breach detected by the Intrusion Detection System. An unauthorized device, currently identified as "unknown," has been detected connected to port 48 within the server room. The device is actively engaging in unauthorized reconnaissance by attempting to probe internal subnets, necessitating an immediate investigation and containment.
resolution: Identified device as an unmanaged switch brought in by a contractor; port was shut down and contractor notified.

title: Notion desktop app black screen

resolution: Cleared the Notion cache directory located in %AppData% and performed a clean re-installation.

title: VPN connection drops after Windows 11 update
description: Hey, is anyone else having issues with AnyConnect since the 23H2 update? Mine keeps dropping every 10 minutes. I’ve already tried flushing the DNS and resetting the adapter, but it’s still super unstable and I can’t get into the shared drive to get any work done.
resolution: Updated the Cisco AnyConnect Secure Mobility Client to the latest version and re-installed the virtual miniport adapter driver.

title: Switch port flapping
description: I am formally reporting a persistent technical failure regarding Port 24 on Switch-Floor-3, which is currently experiencing intermittent connectivity instability. System logs confirm a recurring error, specifically: %LINEPROTO-5-UPDOWN: Line protocol on Interface GigabitEthernet0/24, changed state to down. This ongoing instability is resulting in significant service disruptions for multiple users within the front office and requires immediate investigation and resolution.
resolution: Replaced the damaged Cat6 cabling run between the wall jack and the desk.

title: Performance degradation after migration
description: Ever since you forced this migration from SQL Server 2016 to 2022, the report generation service has become completely unusable. We’re constantly hitting timeouts on the report_gen_sp procedure, and it’s unacceptable that everything was working perfectly fine just yesterday before this upgrade. Fix this now.
resolution: Updated statistics on the affected tables and forced a plan recompile for the stored procedure to utilize the new Cardinality Estimator.

title: Salesforce desktop app crashes on startup
description: Hey, having some trouble with the Salesforce desktop app on my MacBook Pro (macOS Sonoma 14.2). It keeps crashing right when I try to open it. I’ve already tried a reinstall and clearing the cache, but no luck—the logs are showing a SIGABRT error. Could someone take a look? Thanks!
resolution: Updated the Salesforce CLI and cleared the ~/Library/Application Support/Salesforce directory to resolve the corrupted configuration files.

title: Disk space full on File Server
description: I am writing to formally report that the E: drive on server FS01 has reached 98% capacity, resulting in the continuous generation of Event ID 2013 alerts. Please advise whether an expansion of the LUN size can be facilitated to remediate this issue, or if immediate manual intervention is required to purge system logs to restore adequate storage space.
resolution: Expanded the underlying LUN by 500GB via the SAN console and extended the volume in Disk Management.

title: BitLocker recovery screen on boot
description: My Dell Latitude 5420 is completely useless right now because it's stuck on a BitLocker recovery screen immediately after the BIOS post. It’s demanding a 48-digit recovery key that I don't have and was never provided. I need this resolved immediately; I cannot afford to be locked out of my machine any longer.
resolution: Retrieved recovery key from Azure AD portal and successfully unlocked the drive. Performed a 'manage-bde -protectors -adbackup' to ensure future recovery keys are synced.

title: Cannot access shared drive
description: Hey, I’ve lost access to the \\FILESERVER\Finance folder and am getting an 'Access Denied' error. I haven't changed anything on my end, could you take a look at my permissions?
resolution: User was accidentally removed from the 'Finance-Read-Only' security group. Re-added user to the group and verified permission propagation.

title: Network latency spike
description: We are currently encountering persistent packet loss affecting our VoIP telephony services, which has resulted in frequent reports of audio clipping by end users. A technical investigation into the relevant system logs is currently underway to determine the root cause of this performance degradation.
resolution: Reconfigured QoS tags on the core switch to prioritize VoIP traffic over general web browsing.

I’ve tried both Chrome v124 and Edge, but it’s the same broken mess on both. It’s painfully obvious that my session token isn't being parsed correctly by the IDP, and I need this fixed immediately so I can actually get back to work.

title: Compromised machine suspected

Furthermore, I observed an unauthorized prompt indicating a remote connection attempt. Consequently, as a precautionary measure to preserve system integrity, I have disconnected the machine from the network and require an immediate security investigation.
resolution: Isolated machine from VLAN. Ran full scan with CrowdStrike Falcon; identified and quarantined a malicious trojan payload. Re-imaged device to ensure complete remediation.

title: Account locked out again!
description: For the third time today, my domain account is locking me out again the second I try to sign into WS-IT-042. I am doing exactly what I do every other day, so I have no idea why this is suddenly a problem. I have a client demo in 20 minutes, so get this fixed right now—I cannot afford any more downtime.
resolution: Identified a stale credential in Windows Credential Manager related to a mapped drive; cleared stored credentials and reset AD account.

title: Password reset keeps failing
description: Hey, I’ve tried using the self-service portal to reset my domain password three times now, but I keep getting an "Error updating password: Policy violation" message. I’m just trying to set it to my name and a number—any idea what's going on?
resolution: Educated user on password complexity requirements; reset password manually as a one-time courtesy.

title: Slow read/write speeds on shared network drive
description: I am writing to formally report persistent performance degradation affecting the Z: drive, which has resulted in significant latency and operational inefficiencies for end users. Accessing even small Microsoft Excel files requires an unacceptable amount of time, indicating a critical service impairment. Our internal diagnostics confirm that the infrastructure is running on Windows Server 2019, and there is a direct correlation between these latency spikes and the execution of the scheduled daily incremental backup task. Please investigate this matter with urgency, as the current state of the shared drive is impeding standard workflow.
resolution: Adjusted the QoS policy on the network switch and rescheduled the backup window to off-peak hours to reduce I/O contention.

title: Need access to the Marketing shared drive
description: I’ve been waiting forever for access to the 'Marketing_Assets' folder. My team lead already approved this, so I don't understand why I’m still blocked. Can you please just add me already?

description: Hey, I’m running into a loop with Salesforce where it keeps kicking me back to the login page right after I enter my MFA code. I already tried clearing my Chrome cache and cookies, but that didn't help. I'm on macOS Sonoma 14.2 if that helps—any ideas?
resolution: Detected an expired session token in the user's browser profile; cleared site data specifically for the Salesforce domain.

title: Account locked again!
description: I am writing to formally report a recurring technical issue regarding my user account, which has experienced unauthorized lockouts on three separate occasions this week. These incidents have repeatedly interrupted critical client meetings and significantly hindered my professional productivity. I request an immediate investigation into the root cause of these lockouts and a permanent resolution to ensure consistent system access moving forward.
resolution: Identified an old iPad still trying to sync email with an expired password; removed the device from the ActiveSync list.

I’ve wasted enough time troubleshooting this myself by testing multiple cables and even a different laptop, but the wall jack is clearly dead. This is preventing me from getting any work done, so please fix this immediately.
resolution: Traced the wall jack to a disconnected patch cable in the server room; re-patched and tested for signal.

title: Cloud storage bucket permissions
description: Hey team, we’re running into 403 Forbidden errors when trying to push logs to the prod-logs-storage S3 bucket. We’ve already double-checked and the IAM role definitely has s3:PutObject permissions, so not sure why it's still acting up. Any ideas?
resolution: Corrected the bucket policy which was inadvertently blocking access from the VPC endpoint.

title: MFA prompt not appearing
description: I am writing to formally report an ongoing technical issue regarding the ERP system authentication process.
